name: Lee Gyu-hyuk
source:
Son of a widely-popular singer-songwriter. Although he doesn't show it, the title "Silver Spoon" seems to be a heavy burden for him. 

His sensational talent, neat appearance, and friendly personality drew attention to him from the start. [url=/c91640]Do-yoon Han[/url] saved his life when he was at his worst.

Mid-season voting results: 1st place.

[Edited from English Official website]
